questions.question: Which greeting fits an informal letter to a friend?
questions.explanation: Informal letters use relaxed greetings like "Hi Emma," or "Dear Anna,", while formal letters use "Dear Sir or Madam".

questions.question: What usually comes right after the greeting in an informal letter?
options: A friendly opening, like asking how the person is doing
A formal summary of the letter's purpose
questions.explanation: Informal letters usually open in a friendly way, for example "How are you?" or "Thanks for your last letter!", before moving to the main content.

questions.question: Which sign-off fits an informal letter?
questions.explanation: "Best wishes", "Love" or "Take care" are informal sign-offs. "Yours faithfully" and "Yours sincerely" belong in formal letters.

questions.question: Which language feature is typical of informal letters?
options: Formal phrases like "I am writing to enquire about..."
questions.explanation: Informal letters use contractions, everyday words and a personal, chatty tone - as if you were talking to the person.

questions.question: The structure of an informal letter/email is usually:
questions.explanation: An informal letter has five parts: greeting, friendly opening, body (the main content), closing and sign-off.
